description: WAFv2 Web ACL Has No Explicit Enforcing Rate-Based Rule — Review
rationale: No directly configured rate-based rule with Block action was established. AWS WAF Count-only rate rules do not limit traffic. CAPTCHA/Challenge may be conditionally enforcing and require manual review. Firewall Manager, managed rule groups, referenced rule groups and upstream defenses are not assessed.
remediation: Where appropriate configure a rate-based rule with Block action and a validated threshold/scope, or document an equivalent mitigation. Count-only rules do not enforce a limit; assess Firewall Manager and upstream protections separately.
